title: Franklin Mint HO Southern Crescent Limited 1396 Tender Car 1989 FMPM
descriptionText:
Franklin Mint Precision Models HO scale (1:87) tender car for the Southern Railway "Crescent Limited," road number 1396. Die-cast in Southern's dark green livery with gold "SOUTHERN" and "CRESCENT LIMITED" lettering and decorative gold striping, molded coal load in the bin, and ladder/coupler detail. Marked "CRESCENT LIMITED ©1989 FMPM" on the underside.
Tender only — no locomotive, display base, box or paperwork. Companion piece to the matching Franklin Mint 4-6-2 steam locomotive.
Condition: Pre-owned, paint and lettering bright with no chips noted. Please review all photos closely — they are of the actual tender you will receive.
